narrative.overview: The waveform is the logo and moves only when sound moves. Dark-first: Void ground, Ink text, Mute secondary. The blue, violet and magenta signal gradient belongs to live elements and the mark. Big Shoulders Display headlines, Geist Mono UI. The workbench borrows hardware panel controls: graphite panels, knob-capped faders and LED meters. Fumadocs keeps its own theme.
keyCharacteristics: Signal gradient #2A6CFF to #B44CFF to #FF2E88 only on live elements and the mark.
Big Shoulders Display 800/900 headlines, Geist Mono UI and body.
Live waveform from real samples; the still mark at rest.
Graphite workbench panels with LED meters.

rules.name: The Live Rule
rules.body: The gradient appears only while audio or state is above rest. At rest, fall back to Mute, Ink or Graphite edge.

rules.name: The Honest Waveform Rule
rules.body: Nothing is presented as a live waveform unless it draws real output samples. Idle shows the still mark.

rules.name: The Gesture Rule
rules.body: Audio starts only from a user gesture.

rules.name: The Still Rule
rules.body: Motion only follows sound or state. Reduced motion keeps the waveform still; meters may update.
